A wicking filter should be completely wet all of the time. Air is forced through the filter evaporating moisture into the air. These only get wet near the bottom, close to the water supply. The rest of the filter stays dry, and doesn't put enough moisture into the air. I only fill the humidifier once a week with these. I filled the humidifier every other day with other filters that stayed wet all of the time.
